text: The Zamindari system was based on the concept of?
options: Land ownership by the state
Land ownership by the peasants
Land ownership by the Zamindars
Land ownership by the British
explanation: The Zamindari system was a feudal system in which the Zamindars held the land and were responsible for paying taxes to the British. The peasants worked on the land and were required to give a portion of their produce to the Zamindars.

text: The opening of the Suez Canal in 1869 led to?
options: Increased trade between India and Britain
Decreased trade between India and Britain
No significant impact on trade between India and Britain
Increased trade between India and other European countries
correctAnswer: Increased trade between India and Britain
explanation: The opening of the Suez Canal reduced the distance and time required for ships to travel between India and Britain, leading to an increase in trade between the two countries.

text: The Drain of Wealth refers to the?
options: Transfer of wealth from India to Britain through trade
Transfer of wealth from Britain to India through trade
No transfer of wealth between India and Britain
Transfer of wealth from India to other European countries
correctAnswer: Transfer of wealth from India to Britain through trade
explanation: The Drain of Wealth refers to the transfer of wealth from India to Britain through trade, which was a major issue in the Indian economy on the eve of independence.

text: The Drain of Wealth was a major issue in the Indian economy on the eve of independence because it?
options: Led to a decline in the standard of living of Indians
Led to a decline in the standard of living of British people
Had no impact on the standard of living of Indians
Led to an increase in the standard of living of Indians
correctAnswer: Led to a decline in the standard of living of Indians
explanation: The Drain of Wealth led to a decline in the standard of living of Indians as the transfer of wealth from India to Britain reduced the resources available for development and improvement of living standards in India.

text: The Zamindari system was a major obstacle to the development of the Indian economy on the eve of independence because it?
options: Led to a decline in agricultural production
Led to an increase in agricultural production
Had no impact on agricultural production
Led to increased inequality among peasants
correctAnswer: Led to increased inequality among peasants
explanation: The Zamindari system was a major obstacle to the development of the Indian economy on the eve of independence because it led to increased inequality among peasants, which reduced the incentives for investment and innovation in agriculture.
